authoritative_format_source.relevant_layout: AC1018/R2004+ DICTIONARYVAR fields are followed by the owner/reactor/extension-dictionary handle sequence.

independent_implementation_evidence.common_link_observation: Each record is owned by dictionary handle 0x66 and has one reactor to that same dictionary; the NOD key AcDbVariableDictionary targets that dictionary.

implementation.change: For AC1018, mark the DICTIONARYVAR common link tail validated only when the parsed handle sequence reaches the end of its bounded object frame with fewer than eight alignment bits remaining. Later versions retain their existing separately bounded-tail behavior.

focused_source_profile.assertions: Three typed values, unique owner keys, schema values, owner links, one reactor per record, empty extension data, and complete AC1018 common-tail frame qualification.
